author: Catholic Church (promulgated by John Paul II, 1992; Latin editio typica 1997)
work: Catechism of the Catholic Church (official English translation, 2nd edition, on vatican.va)
notes: Read in the English translation on vatican.va (#1010), because the Latin typical edition pages (archive/catechism_lt) are served in several byte variants and CI could not materialize them. Claims carry basis translation; upgrade to the Latin when a byte-stable Latin host is pinnable. The Catechism is addressed chiefly to bishops and, through them, to catechists and priests (CCC 12, read in the Latin, not pinned).
